sum: Yatra Online, Inc. operates as an online travel company in India and internationally. The company operates through Air Ticketing; Hotels and Packages; and Other Services segments. It offers travel-related services, including domestic and international air ticketing, bus ticketing, rail ticketing, cab bookings and ancillary services for leisure and business travelers, as well as hotels, homestays, and other accommodations. The company also provides visa facilitation, tours, sightseeing, shows, and events, as well as holiday packages. It offers its services through its mobile applications, website, and network of travel agents. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is based in Gurugram, India.
